designationHistory.name: Dixie Forest Reserve
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt proclaimed the Dixie Forest Reserve in Utah.
designationHistory.note: UCSB's '593' is the American Presidency Project's own document number, not an official proclamation number.

sources.name: Proclamation of Sept. 25, 1905, 34 Stat. 3147 (govinfo, Statutes at Large)

designationHistory.name: Dixie National Forest
designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided that forest reserves would be known as national forests, so the Dixie Forest Reserve became the Dixie National Forest.
designationHistory.note: Approved by President Theodore Roosevelt at 9:43 a.m. on Mar. 4, 1907 (the act's approval line). Mar. 4, 1907 was not an inauguration day.
